title: Add a search bar to the FAQ & Help Center page

requirements.text: Add a client-side search bar to the FAQ & Help Center page (frontend/src/pages/FaqHelpCenterPage.tsx) that filters the displayed FAQ items by the user’s query.

quotes: yes lets build a search bar

acceptanceCriteria: FAQ page shows a visible search input near the top of the FAQ content (under the title/intro).
Typing a query filters FAQ entries in-place without navigating away or requiring authentication.
Search matches against the question text and answer text (case-insensitive).
When the search box is empty, the full original FAQ content is shown (no content loss).

requirements.text: Refactor the FAQ page content into a structured in-component data model (e.g., sections -> items with question/answer strings) so filtering can be applied without duplicating markup.

quotes: yes lets build a search bar

acceptanceCriteria: FAQ sections and Q/A content remain exactly the same as before when no search is applied (including the support email and mailto link).
Filtering is applied based on the data model and the UI is rendered from that model (no hardcoded duplicated Q/A blocks for filtered vs unfiltered states).

requirements.text: Define clear empty-state behavior for the FAQ search: when no questions match the query, show an English “no results” message and provide a one-click way to clear the search.

quotes: yes lets build a search bar

acceptanceCriteria: If the query returns zero matches, the page shows a friendly English message such as “No results found” within the FAQ card content area.
A clear action is available (e.g., a clear button) that resets the query to empty and restores all FAQ content.
Clearing the query restores the original section ordering and all entries.

requirements.text: Ensure the search UI matches the existing visual system used on the FAQ page (Card layout, typography, spacing, and existing amber accent usage).

quotes: yes lets build a search bar

acceptanceCriteria: Search input styling is consistent with the app’s Tailwind/shadcn look-and-feel on the FAQ page (no unstyled default input).
Search control has an accessible label (visible or aria-label) and reasonable focus styles.
The search bar does not break the current responsive layout of the FAQ page.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead of modifying them).
Implement search purely on the client; no backend changes are required.
nonGoals: Implementing backend/full-text search or persisting search queries server-side.
Adding new FAQ content or changing the meaning/text of existing FAQ questions/answers.
Adding real-time analytics/telemetry for search usage.
